[Intro]
[Em]Reluctantly crouched at the starting line
Engines pumping and thumping in time The
green light flashes, the flags go up
Churning and burning, they yearn for the cup. They

[Verse 1]
[Em]Deftly maneuver and muscle for rank
Fuel burning fast on an empty tank
Reckless and wild, they pour through the turns Their
prowess is potent and secretly stern As they
speed through the finish, the flags go down The
fans [G]get up and they [Em]get out of town The a-
rena is empty except for one man Still
driving and striving as fast as he can The

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em]sun has gone down and the moon has come up And
long ago somebody left with the cup But he's
driving and striving and hugging the turns And
thinking of someone for whom he still burns
He's going the

[Chorus]
[Em]Distance He's going for
speed She's all a-
lone All alone in her time of
need Because he's
racing and pacing [Bm7]and plotting the course He's
fighting and biting [Em]and riding on his horse
He's going [Bm7]the distance
[Em]

[Bridge]
[Em]
No

[Em]Trophy, no flowers, no flashbulbs, no wine He's
haunted by something he cannot define

mind, he's still driving, still making the grade She's

racing and pacing and plotting the course He's
